## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

*Sanidassanattika, Upādinnaduka* (Patthana 16.76) is an Abhidhamma text located within the *Paṭṭhāna* section of the Pali Canon. Categorized as a leaf text within the collection, it treats the synthesis of the triad on visibility (*sanidassanattika*) with the dyad on being attached or clung to (*upādinnaduka*).

No external cross-language parallels in Chinese, Tibetan, or Sanskrit are recorded in the corpus [DharmaNexus]. However, automated analysis by DharmaNexus documents substantial internal formulaic overlap within the Pali canon, identifying 157 shared passages across 51 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The highest volume of shared textual material occurs with other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna* combining the *sanidassanattika* with various dyads and triads, foremost among them *Sanidassanattika, Sappaṭighaduka* (Patthana 16.54), *Sanidassanattika, Kusalattika* (Patthana 17.27), *Sanidassanattika, Savitakkaduka* (Patthana 16.82), *Sanidassanattika, Sappītikaduka* (Patthana 16.84), and *Sanidassanattika, Upekkhāsahagataduka* (Patthana 16.87) [DharmaNexus].
